title: China Market Crash: The Reflexive Cascade
objective: Deconstruct China's 2026 stock market crash as a high-stakes psychological story of reflexive deleveraging and retail herd panic.
audience: Curious finance and tech viewers on mobile looking for a gripping, cinematic narrative behind market crashes.

message.core_message: When millions of retail traders buy stocks on triple leverage, a tiny dip triggers automated liquidation and a stampede where state bailouts cannot print confidence.
key_points: Retail euphoria drove massive margin borrowing
A 2% dip triggered automatic 1/L collateral wipeouts
90% retail dominance created an instantaneous panic stampede
State ETF bailouts cannot arrest reflexive deleveraging without confidence

constraints: Reel safe margins respected (10% top, 20% bottom)

research.reason: Derived from validated research dossier in projects/china-market-crash-2026/research.json

creative_directions.name: Cinematic Bloomberg Terminal Thriller
creative_directions.concept: A dark obsidian digital terminal world where a glowing green phone trading app shatters into an automated liquidation cascade, flowing into a vertical avalanche of panic sell orders.

visual_identity.palette: Obsidian matte base (#090c12), terminal amber (#f59e0b), panic crimson (#ff334b), electric cyan (#38bdf8)
visual_identity.typography: JetBrains Mono / monospace kicker and values, Inter / Grotesk display headers, condensed stats
visual_identity.texture: Fine CRT phosphor scanlines and subtle terminal grid

motion_language.transitions: Directional camera push down, glitch cuts, and match-cuts

composition.approach: Vertical 9:16 hero staging with top HUD telemetry and central dynamic motion stage

creative_directions.pacing: Builds from rhythmic green optimism to sudden jarring red alarm, fast stampede, and heavy concluding silence
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Fits short-form vertical video storytelling perfectly with maximum thumb-stopping visual hook.

creative_directions.name: Swiss Brutalist Fact Sheet
creative_directions.concept: High contrast black and white documentary layout with heavy typographic blocks and bold architectural grids.

visual_identity.palette: Stark paper (#f5f5f5), jet black (#0a0a0a), signal red (#ff0033)
visual_identity.typography: Heavy grotesk display, clean sans body

creative_directions.why_it_fits: Clean and objective, but less emotionally gripping for short-form social video.
